secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI chat/conversation feature. Optional — the app boots without it, but the AI feature won't work until it's set. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: CINETPAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: CinetPay API key for membership subscription payments (Côte d'Ivoire / West Africa). Optional — the app boots without it, but payment initiation won't work. Get it from the CinetPay merchant dashboard.

secrets.name: CINETPAY_SITE_ID
secrets.description: CinetPay Site ID for payment integration. Optional — paired with CINETPAY_API_KEY. Get it from the CinetPay merchant dashboard.
